interpretation: A patch survives unless some gate fails. A gate fails only when the patch's [min, max] for that feature cannot overlap [lo, hi]. Missing data is unknown and passes.

gates.note: Proxy: mean over the supplied months of monthly snow-cover fraction (MOD10CM, 0.05 deg). Not a count of snow days. Tolerance is NOT calibrated: no fine-scale reference for this feature is on hand, so it is a wide value fixed before any search. Needs review.

Proxy: maximum over the supplied months of monthly-mean daytime LST (MOD11C3, 0.05 deg). The Phase 1 feature is the maximum clear-sky daily LST in local summer at 1 km. Tolerance 15 degC = 5 degC (within-feature fine tolerance) + 9.5 to 9.7 degC (p95 of |gap_seed - gap_candidate|, where gap = 1 km daily extreme minus coarse monthly value), rounded up. Measured on six non-seed tiles (Sahara, Tibet, Atacama, Siberia, Greenland, East Antarctica; Jan+Jul 2025; docs/prefilter.md). Fixed before search; review with Ryan.

Proxy: minimum over the supplied months of monthly-mean night LST (MOD11C3, 0.05 deg). The Phase 1 feature is the minimum clear-sky LST in local winter at 1 km. Polar night leaves gaps, which count as unknown and never prune. Tolerance 15 degC = 5 degC (within-feature fine tolerance) + 9.5 to 9.7 degC (p95 of |gap_seed - gap_candidate|, where gap = 1 km daily extreme minus coarse monthly value), rounded up. Measured on six non-seed tiles (Sahara, Tibet, Atacama, Siberia, Greenland, East Antarctica; Jan+Jul 2025; docs/prefilter.md). Fixed before search; review with Ryan.

not_gates.reason: informative only: Phase 1: do not threshold elevation as a Mars-analog score. Reported for context only; never a gate.
